sourceRefs.locator: CUL T-S 20.47. Translation, opening dating clause and list of scrolls and textiles. Details identifies the language of the inventory as Judeo-Arabic.
Description and translation of T-S 20.47, 1r. The inventory dated 8 Tammuz 1391 Seleucid records objects owned by the Iraqi congregation and stored in the Palestinian synagogue in Fustat.
Synagogue, item 3, inventory dated 1080, T-S 20.47. Schoolroom, item 2, letter T-S Ar.53.65, separately dated to the eleventh or twelfth century.
Translated letter and catalogue data for T-S Ar.53.65, including the note about the child’s writing board.
Account of the foundation of the Fatimid city in 969 in relation to the older settlements.

labels.en: A synagogue’s furnishings in an inventory

note.de: Ein judäo-arabisches Inventar von 1080 erfasst Eigentum der irakischen Gemeinde, das die palästinische Synagoge in Fustat verwahrte. Der Lehrerbrief ist gesondert datiert. Die Karte zeigt den Standort der Geniza.
note.en: A Judaeo-Arabic inventory from 1080 lists property of the Iraqi congregation kept at the Palestinian synagogue in Fustat. The teacher’s letter has a separate date. The map marks the site of the Genizah.
